It consists of 4,000 synthetic QA pairs about fictitious authors, for which we employ a split of 10% as the forget set and the remaining 90% as the retain set in our experimental setup.
outputs: The model generates answers to questions, which are evaluated for knowledge unlearning and retention.

quote: we incorporate Extraction Strength (ES). ES has recently been proposed as a robust alternative to traditional metrics such as Perplexity and ROUGE-L

we adopt Forget Quality (FQ) and Model Utility (MU) as provided by TOFU, but also incorporate Extraction Strength (ES)... ES is computed on forget and retain sets, defining Forget Strength (FS) as 1 -ES forget and Retain Strength (RS) as ES retain
